verdict.rationale: DPMA is the German patent and trade mark office. Its offerings are patent search (DEPATISnet), the official register (DPMAregister) and e-filing services (DPMAdirektWeb/Pro). It is not an AI agent or assistant host that would act as an MCP client, so plugging MCP servers into it is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any agent or MCP-client capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
